purpose: separate task-structure inference from evidence application and measure one Agent Router turn amortized over twelve stages

task_only.interpretation: tests whether an Agent can infer model-specific Profile utility from task structure without outcome evidence

evidence_bound.interpretation: tests exact application fidelity and token overhead when verified Profile evidence is supplied

scoring.exact_plan_accuracy: fraction of repetitions matching all twelve expected routes
scoring.stage_accuracy: correct stage actions divided by twelve
scoring.stability: identical valid plans divided by three within each condition
scoring.router_cost: complete Codex input plus output tokens for one twelve-stage plan
scoring.cost_boundary: a correct Agent plan is still more expensive than the zero-token evidence table; report whether its median cost also exceeds the measured Rankcount Worker saving

claim_boundary: The evidence-bound condition is evaluated on the same six-family outcomes and measures application fidelity plus overhead, not held-out generalization. The task-only condition tests structural inference but was designed after the family outcomes and remains development evidence.
